name: Switch
description: The Switch component provides a toggle control that allows users to switch between two states (on/off).
usage: Three size options: small, medium, and large
examples:
<Switch id="small-switch" checked={checked} onChange={handleChange} size="sm" label="Small" />
<Switch id="medium-switch" checked={checked} onChange={handleChange} size="md" label="Medium" />
<Switch id="large-switch" checked={checked} onChange={handleChange} size="lg" label="Large" />

<Switch
  id="disabled-switch"
  checked={true}
  onChange={() => {}}
  disabled={true}
  label="Disabled switch"
/>

// uncontrolled, named without a visible label
<Switch defaultChecked aria-label="Notifications" onChange={save} />
design: Focus ring: keyboard only (focus-visible), 2px var(--color-border-focus) with offset
accessibility: A native checkbox (visually hidden) with role="switch": Space toggles it, and assistive technology announces a switch, on or off
Named by its label, by aria-label, or by an outside <label htmlFor={id}>
Keyboard focus ring on the track (focus-visible)
Disabled sets the native disabled attribute

props.name: id
props.description: The input's id; generated with useId() when left out

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled: on or off. Leave out for uncontrolled

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new state, value first

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Without it, pass aria-label or label it from outside with <label htmlFor={id}>

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root (merged with cn)

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Every other prop (aria-label, name, data-*, onBlur…) goes to the input
